def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    cur = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * cur) % mod
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    MOD = 1000000007
    if m == 0:
        print(power_mod(n, n - 1, MOD))
    elif m == 1:
        print(power_mod(n, n, MOD))
    else:
        parent = list(range(n + 1))
        size = [0] * (n + 1)

        def find_set(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x

        def union_sets(a, b):
            pa = find_set(a)
            pb = find_set(b)
            if pa != pb:
                parent[pb] = pa

        for i in range(1, n):
            b = (i * m) % n
            union_sets(i, b)

        unique_parents = set()
        for i in range(1, n):
            unique_parents.add(find_set(i))
        count = len(unique_parents)
        print(power_mod(n, count, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
